page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AES cryptography. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.r7t.8xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory metrics. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1842.78, while multi-core performance reaches 31113.04. Memory bandwidth tests show 1708.58 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 153.12 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. In database operations, the instance achieves a PassMark database score of 14663.56 and processes 31.33 million Redis SET operations per second. Notably, text generation for a small 135M LLM model demonstrates strong performance at 312.77 tokens per second, though larger 7B model text generation remains average at 18.6 tokens per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7t.8xlarge offers a dense memory allocation relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-heavy workloads without the overhead of higher-tier compute-optimized instances. However, the complete absence of local storage requires users to factor in the cost and latency of network-attached storage. The instance is suited for memory-intensive applications, including database operations, caching layers like Redis, static web serving, and moderate-scale language model inference.
